reviewer: Authoring research agent; not independent reviewer
method: Read retained primary statement rows and column headers, all fact values and unique evidence texts; recomputed formulas and bridges; inspected first-party model-company disclosures and visual PDF tables. Browser interaction and desktop/mobile screenshots reviewed.
verified: Thirteen financial comparison objects, fifty actual observations; annual and quarterly series never joined
Broadcom prior-year quarter is numeric column 2, not sequential quarter column 1
Microsoft earnings release contains two quarterly and two annual columns; annual release is unaudited
AMD total revenue and data-center segment distinguished from embedded/client rows
NVIDIA Data Center platform distinguished from Compute & Networking segment
Palantir thousands converted to millions; TSMC USD revenue and TIFRS operating margin explicitly separate
Google Cloud TPU system product revenue retained in comparability warning
ServiceNow subscription cost drivers preserve acquisition amortization and residual
Salesforce Informatica contribution separated; residual proxy not labeled organic growth; Agentforce ARR definition expansion disclosed
CoreWeave adjusted EBITDA-to-net-loss reconciles all six adjustments
Four April-June group cash panels aligned, Amazon capex net of proceeds; Meta financing-lease principal reconciled to company FCF
Private-company reports retain disclosure dates and lack of comparable audited financials
Direct hyperlinks and raw row/section locators are exposed in the report
disclosed_limitations: Representative sample, not global AI market census; Oracle, Alibaba Cloud, Korean memory makers and physical AI not fully modeled
Quarter ends differ between May and August 2026; figures are not a synchronized calendar-quarter peer panel
Company and segment revenue is not uniformly AI-only; value-chain revenue is not summed into market size
Group cash capex excludes noncash lease additions and is not AI-only investment
Private model revenue run rates are company disclosures at different dates, not annual audited results or a current relative market-share estimate
Scenario uses illustrative assumptions and omits fixed costs; not a company forecast
Same-agent validation with no independent accuracy rate or audit assurance
